title: Homogeneous quotient action on degree kernels before cohomology
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion, $L$ invertible and $J=j.\ker$ have $J^2=0$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sc-invertible-module, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Fix $n,e\geq0$, a TensorGradedPresentation $T$ [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation], and canonical comparisons $D$ [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Put $F=j^*(J\otimes L^n)$, $N=(j^*L)^n$, and let $x:\mathcal O_Z\to N^{e+1}$ and $t=\mathrm{tensorGradedSection}(T,D,e,x)$ [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-product-projection]. Suppose local ring actions $\sigma_U$ on $T.I(U)$ satisfy $i(\sigma_U(p(b))y)=b\,i(y)$, and a global endomorphism action $\mu$ satisfies $(\mu(g))_U(y)=\sigma_U(g|_U)y$. Write $\pi_r=(T.degree(n(r+1))).\tau_1$. Then $\mu(t);\pi_{e+1}=\pi_0;m$, where $m:K_0\to K_{e+1}$ is the explicit transported kernel map for $\mathrm{id}_F\otimes x$ [lem-sc-tensor-boundary-kernel-map-naturality]. No cohomology action or cohomology class is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Substitute hD to fix the section comparison. Check equality after all k_d by the colimit property. Locally lift x in degree n(e+1) through the surjective degreewise unit. Apply hlocal to that lift and to k_d, and cancel the monomorphism i. Use b_quotient, k_inclusion, and b_multiply to compute the product in degree d+n(e+1).

If d differs from n, k_orthogonal kills the output and input projections; equality d+n(e+1)=n(e+2) implies d=n, including n=0. For d=n use k_projection and the defining inclusion equation of the ideal-kernel comparison to identify the product with the transported tensor-by-x map. The coefficient-degree comparison records the same tensor associativity. In a local generator ell, a kernel element has inclusion r ell^d with r in J and x has a lift a ell^(n(e+1)); the product is ar ell^(d+n(e+1)). The defining ideal inclusion identifies r, the annihilated-module unit reduces it to Z, and the recursive tensor comparisons preserve the pure generator tensors, including the unitors for exponent zero.

A different lift differs by a kernel section and contributes zero by squareZero. Equality on the local cover glues by sheaf separation. Use hglobal to identify the sheaf action with mu. The colimit property gives equality of the whole morphisms.
